description: This file defines HTTP handlers and core logic for managing executions within a control plane, including synchronous and asynchronous execution requests, status updates, webhooks, and related workflow management. It interacts with external systems via HTTP, manages execution state, emits events, and orchestrates complex execution workflows.

classes.name: executionController
classes.description: Controller handling execution HTTP endpoints, orchestrating execution workflows, status updates, event publishing, and webhook triggers.

classes.name: asyncExecutionJob
classes.description: Represents a job for asynchronous execution processing, linked to the controller and execution plan.

classes.name: asyncWorkerPool
classes.description: Worker pool managing concurrent execution of async jobs with a fixed number of workers and job queue.

classes.name: completionJob
classes.description: Represents a job to finalize execution, either completing or failing it, with result and error info.

methods.name: ExecuteHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler for synchronous execution requests.

methods.name: ExecuteAsyncHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler for asynchronous execution requests.

methods.name: GetExecutionStatusHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler for fetching the status of a single execution.

methods.name: BatchExecutionStatusHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler for fetching statuses of multiple executions.

methods.name: UpdateExecutionStatusHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler to process status callbacks from agents.

methods.name: prepareExecution
methods.description: Prepares an execution plan by parsing request input, target, agent, and registering payloads and webhooks.

methods.name: callAgent
methods.description: Invokes the target agent to execute a task, handling synchronous and async acknowledgment responses.

methods.name: completeExecution
methods.description: Finalizes an execution with success result, updates state, emits events, and triggers webhooks.

methods.name: failExecution
methods.description: Marks an execution as failed, records error, and emits failure events.

methods.name: publishExecutionEvent
methods.description: Emits an event indicating execution status change.

methods.name: publishExecutionEventWithReasonerInfo
methods.description: Emits detailed event with reasoner and agent info.

methods.name: publishExecutionStartedEvent
methods.description: Emits event signaling execution start, including reasoner context.

methods.name: waitForExecutionCompletion
methods.description: Subscribes to event bus to wait for execution completion event.

methods.name: buildWorkflowExecutionRecord
methods.description: Constructs a record for a workflow execution based on base execution and target details.

methods.name: updateWorkflowExecutionFinalState
methods.description: Updates the workflow execution record to final state with result and timing.

methods.name: ensureWorkflowExecutionRecord
methods.description: Ensures a workflow execution record exists in store for a given execution.

methods.name: parseTarget
methods.description: Parses target string into node and reasoner name.

methods.name: determineTargetType
methods.description: Determines if the target is a reasoner or skill based on agent info.

methods.name: buildAgentURL
methods.description: Constructs URL for agent invocation based on deployment type and target.

methods.name: normalizeWebhookRequest
methods.description: Validates and normalizes webhook registration parameters.

methods.name: decodeJSON
methods.description: Decodes payload bytes into an interface, fallback to string if invalid JSON.

methods.name: renderStatus
methods.description: Renders execution status response object from execution record.

methods.name: savePayload
methods.description: Persists payload bytes and returns URI.

methods.name: processCompletionJob
methods.description: Processes a completion job, finalizing execution, handling errors.
